summary.text:
Evaluate each.

V05: reference detail page vs candidate 0028. Layout matches: thumbnails left, main image, right info column, breadcrumbs, price, color swatches. Differences: breadcrumb truncated in candidate (ends "BESTÅ"), search box shows "besta" text, missing "Design it yourself" section, missing All media/View in 3D buttons (actually candidate lacks those buttons at image bottom... not visible), color swatch grid differs (16 items vs 14 + "+12"), add-to-bag visible in candidate. Overall key layout correct with minor differences → 0.75.

V06: All media modal. Reference: white modal over dimmed backdrop, tabs All media/Video/Measurement, two large images side by side, close X top right, scrollbar. Candidate: modal present, tabs same, close X, image grid (4 top + 4 second row), dimmed backdrop. Differences: grid density (2 columns large vs 4 columns smaller), IKEA logo visible behind modal in candidate (modal less wide?), page content visible at right edge. Reference modal covers most of viewport. Candidate modal slightly smaller/positioned. Layout recognizable with multiple notable differences → 0.75? Criteria: 遮罩、白色大弹层、媒体标签、图片栅格及关闭位置 — all present. Grid differs in column count and image sizing. I'd say 0.75, maybe 0.75. Reference shows 2 large images; candidate 4-column grid. That's a noticeable grid difference but key layout correct. 0.75.

V07: What's included tab. Reference: tabs horizontal, 2-column component cards left, large product image right, quantities, black article-number labels. Candidate: 3-column grid of 6 cards, no right large image, article numbers in plain text (some wrong/duplicated like "902.473.75" repeated and "20293568" without dots), images lighter. Criteria: 横向标签、六种组件图文、数量、右侧大图和层级 — candidate has tabs, six components with quantities, but lacks right large image (an important part missing) → 0.5. Per anchor: .5 = 可辨认同页面但有多处明显差异或一个重要部分缺失. Right large image missing = one important part missing → 0.5.

V08: STUBBARP leg page. Reference: main image shows two legs with screw tops, left thumbnails, right info with price $8.00/2 pack, color swatches, qty stepper, Add to bag. Candidate: main image shows a single leg under cabinet (different selected image, but allowed—image differences? The state is the same page; main image differs because different gallery selection. Reference main image = product shot of two legs; candidate = lifestyle-ish close-up). Layout matches: price, /2 pack, swatches, stepper, add to bag. Selected swatch differs (candidate selected black swatch while showing oak? minor). Criteria: STUBBARP 配件大图、2 pack价格说明、数量步进与加入按钮 — all present. Main image content differs significantly (two-leg product shot vs single leg close-up). That's a notable image difference but page structure matches. 0.75 seems right — key layout correct, minor/local differences. The image difference is more than minor though; it's the main visual. But allowed "静态宣传视频照片差异"? That refers to not penalizing missing provided assets. Hmm. The candidate selected a different gallery image as main. Structure/proportion/hierarchy match. I'd give 0.75.
